description_en: You can invoke RemoveUsers to delete one or more agents from a specified instance. This operation only detaches the RAM accounts from the instance and removes the agents mapped to those RAM accounts from the instance. It does not delete the RAM accounts themselves
description_zh: 调用RemoveUsers删除指定实例下的一个或多个坐席，该操作仅将RAM账户与实例解绑，然后将RAM账户映射的坐席从实例中删除，并不会删除RAM账户本身
kebab_example: aliyun ccc remove-users --instance-id ccc-test --user-id-list '["agent1@ccc-test","agent2@ccc-test"]' --biz-force true --file-path temp/removeUsers.xlsx --notification-email 123@abc.com --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveUsers

parameters.help_en: A JSON-formatted string representing an array of agent IDs. Each array element is an agent ID
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID列表，格式为JSON数组的字符串，数组元素是坐席ID
parameters.name: user_id_list

parameters.help_en: The ObjectKey of the OSS object containing the file with the list of users to delete
parameters.help_zh: 待删除用户列表文件的OSS对象的ObjectKey
parameters.name: file_path
